text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear anti-driverless stance throughout","quality":"argumentative focus","description":"It stays consistently on one claim and develops that position across the essay rather than wavering or mixing in conflicting support."},{"evidence":"law, safety, and liability points","quality":"relevant support","description":"It uses article-based reasons that directly address the assignment’s prompt and strengthen the argument against driverless cars."},{"evidence":"\"lots of problems arise\" and \"who takes the blame\"","quality":"counterargument development","description":"It acknowledges major objections and unanswered questions about driverless cars in a way that makes the opposition feel more substantial."},{"evidence":"body paragraphs that build from laws to car functions to legal issues","quality":"organization","description":"It presents its reasons in a clear sequence that is easier to follow than the more repetitive structure of the other essay."},{"evidence":"fewer vague restatements like \"people friendly\" and \"safe place\"","quality":"precision","description":"It relies more on concrete claims and less on broad, unsupported generalizations."}]}
